narrative.details:
A trick-or-treater!  Huzzah!

Well now, even though you're doing something noble and collecting candies for a sick child, I can't let you off the hook that easily.  I have a yummy Gnomeregan Gumdrop to give to the sick child... if you make a train noise for me!  Haha, yes, that'll be the trick!  The price of this gumdrop is one train noise!

Chugga-chugga, champion!
narrative.objectives: Do a train emote at Talvash del Kissel, and in exchange you'll receive a Gnomeregan Gumdrop!
narrative.offerRewardText:
Too funny!  Well done, adventurer! Here's your treat.

Happy Hallow's End!
